standard: Visible refinements acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or production release approval. Retained simplifications and source naming limitations are identified explicitly.

front.note: Dark uprights, paired iron scrolls and small gold fittings read clearly as a decorative railing.

rear.note: Rear scrolls remain joined to the pickets and surrounding frame.

detail.note: Smooth curled bars and small leaf-like fittings have legible construction and restrained highlights.

underside.note: Lower rail and both mounting feet remain connected with closed undersides.

clay.note: Open scroll pattern stays recognizable without material contrast; no silhouette break is visible.

front.note: Warm directional wood grain makes the vertical slats and top cap more convincing.

rear.note: Slats remain evenly separated and connected within the dark support frame.

detail.note: End fixings and restrained edge highlights preserve individual board construction.

underside.note: Rail underside and mounting plates remain closed and joined to the posts.

clay.note: The repeated slats retain real depth and consistent gaps without relying on texture.

front.note: Four colored spool bays remain visible through the transparent front enclosure.

rear.note: Distinct spool rims and opaque side walls retain the authored device layout.

detail.note: Spool lips and cover edge remain clear; glazing does not obscure their separation.

underside.note: Closed dark base and small front label remain intact beneath the enclosure.

clay.note: Case seams and lid thickness stay legible; this is a restrained housing refinement.

front.note: Enclosed printer retains its glass door, handle, hinges and small display.

rear.note: Rear ventilation slots and squared enclosure remain coherent with softly finished edges.

detail.note: Control panel markings, hinge contacts and layered top trim remain legible.

underside.note: Closed bottom and feet remain attached while the door frame stays aligned.

clay.note: Panel joints and door outline remain clear without materials; no unsupported part is apparent.

front.note: Open cabinet, narrow bottle divisions and tapered legs read as a compact dry bar.

rear.note: Rear panels remain closed and joined with a visible horizontal construction seam.

detail.note: Small stemware supports and fine panel edges are visible; timber remains a simple pale finish.

underside.note: Underside exposes the hanging-glass rails and closed lower cabinet with seated legs.

clay.note: Open compartments and thin dividers remain geometric rather than texture-only details.

front.note: Two trays, high pushing handles and four small casters remain coherent.

rear.note: Rear handle rails and shelf supports are joined without missing corners.

detail.note: Tray lips and raised handle construction gain controlled edge highlights; walnut color remains understated.

underside.note: Caster wheels and closed shelf bottoms remain attached to the upright frame.

clay.note: Two-level serving-cart silhouette and raised handles remain clear without color.

front.note: Request correction: the back pad visibly floats above the seat with no supporting structure.

rear.note: Rear view confirms no back uprights or bracket linking the pad to the seat pan.

detail.note: Seat tailoring is improved, but unsupported back construction prevents visual acceptance.

underside.note: Circular footrest sits between the four legs without connecting braces; add measured supports within bounds.

clay.note: The material-free view confirms both missing support paths are geometric defects.

front.note: Two doors, recessed plinth and thick white counter form a clear base cabinet.

rear.note: Closed rear and side panels meet the counter cleanly with restrained edge highlights.

detail.note: Door gaps and narrow dark handles stay aligned beneath the countertop overhang.

underside.note: Recessed dark plinth and closed bottom retain clear construction.

clay.note: Door separation and counter thickness remain legible without color or surface effects.

front.note: Original orange basketball figure and hoop remain intact in the warm narrow frame.

rear.note: Plain backing remains enclosed with clean perimeter contacts.

detail.note: Figure linework and print texture stay crisp while the physical frame edge is gently softened.

underside.note: Bottom and side rails remain attached around the full portrait composition.

clay.note: Shallow frame construction remains even; no new geometry intrudes onto the artwork.

front.note: Shallow casing and cover fasteners retain a clean low-profile ceiling fixture.

rear.note: Back cover remains closed and aligned with the softly rounded white surround.

detail.note: Small cover slots and narrow layered seam remain visible at close range.

underside.note: The actual ventilation face has many separate parallel louvres seated inside its frame.

clay.note: Cover thickness and rounded perimeter remain clear; grille is principally visible from below as expected.

front.note: Six softly finished wooden slats form the open seat over metal supports.

rear.note: Rear mounting brackets meet the seat boards without detached ends.

detail.note: Board gaps and rounded slat corners remain clear; teak color is still deliberately plain.

underside.note: Triangular folding braces and transverse rails remain connected beneath the seat.

clay.note: Slats and hinged bracket structure remain legible without material contrast.

front.note: Straight silver grip joins two gold mounting collars with a clear wall offset.

rear.note: Closed circular mounting backs stay aligned with the horizontal bar.

detail.note: Fine cylindrical highlights and small end collars remain controlled at close range.

underside.note: Both bent end connections remain seated in their mounting plates.

clay.note: The straight grip and two wall contacts form a coherent machined-bar silhouette.

front.note: Tall grip and paired wall mounts remain straight and clearly separated from the wall plane.

rear.note: Both circular rear plates are closed and aligned vertically.

detail.note: Metal grip has restrained longitudinal highlights without distorted contour.

underside.note: Upper and lower bent connectors meet the gold collars without gaps.

clay.note: The vertical bar and two offsets remain legible without metallic response.

front.note: Curved horizontal rails form a coherent ladder-like heater between two uprights.

rear.note: Four wall contacts remain visible and aligned behind the frame.

detail.note: Repeated rail ends meet the uprights; reflective metal stays restrained and readable.

underside.note: Lower fittings and wall offsets remain attached with no floating rail ends.

clay.note: The repeated curved rails remain clear geometry rather than a flat grille texture.

front.note: Two framed mirror doors and central handles sit inside the rounded white cabinet.

rear.note: Continuous rear casing remains closed and evenly finished.

detail.note: Fine warm door borders and narrow central gap remain aligned.

underside.note: Both mirror faces retain a clean reflection while bottom cabinet depth remains visible.

clay.note: Door frames, handles and casing thickness remain distinct in the plain material view.

front.note: Round glass and layered pale surround retain a clear halo-mirror silhouette.

rear.note: Closed circular backing has a continuous soft edge.

detail.note: Thin inner rim and raised outer surround remain separated; slight faceting is restrained at application scale.

underside.note: Reflective face remains continuous inside the circular surround.

clay.note: Concentric frame layers remain legible without reflectivity or color.

front.note: Capsule outline is intact, but a vertical shading crease is visible in the reflective face.

rear.note: Closed backing retains the same false central shading division, requiring a planar-surface check.

detail.note: Request correction: the tall glass face should read flat, not folded along a vertical ridge.

underside.note: Strong reflected highlight makes the false central fold unmistakable; correct source cap normals while preserving silhouette.

clay.note: Frame shape is acceptable; the defect is surface shading rather than missing perimeter geometry.

front.note: Rounded rectangular mirror retains a clean continuous pale surround.

rear.note: Closed rear panel and soft corners remain even without an exposed seam.

detail.note: Thin glass border stays aligned to the rounded frame at close range.

underside.note: Reflected light reads as a continuous face without the capsule mirror central crease.

clay.note: Consistent frame depth and rounded corners remain clear in clay.

front.note: Low white mat has a softly finished perimeter and restrained parallel ribs.

rear.note: Rear angle retains the same shallow, level rug construction.

detail.note: Fine ribbing remains legible without exaggerated coarse cloth relief.

underside.note: Closed dark backing sits beneath the light rim with no missing corner.

clay.note: Modeled parallel channels remain visible independently of the white material.

front.note: Two upturned hooks and a round gold mounting plate remain clearly readable.

rear.note: Closed rear disc remains attached to both forward hook arms.

detail.note: Squared bends and rounded end caps form coherent machined hardware; metal grain remains restrained.

underside.note: Hook arms meet the stepped plate, with the small fixing detail visible below.

clay.note: Double-hook silhouette remains clear without metallic highlights.

front.note: Three triangular wire shelves and tall supports form a clear corner caddy.

rear.note: Upper mounting caps and rear rods remain connected to all shelf levels.

detail.note: Individual shelf rods and raised front guards are separated and readable.

underside.note: Each shelf has a coherent wire base; lower hooks remain attached.

clay.note: Open triangular construction stays clear without material contrast.

front.note: Recessed tub, glass screen and tall shower fittings read as one complete fixture.

rear.note: Back wall and tub shell remain continuous with no exposed missing surfaces.

detail.note: Handset, hose, rail, tub faucet and drain remain distinct at close range.

underside.note: Closed tub underside and tall wall assembly remain connected.

clay.note: Tub cavity and separate screen remain legible independently of transparency or white gloss.

front.note: Repeated green folds hang coherently from rings along a continuous rod.

rear.note: Rear folds retain the same depth and even suspension.

detail.note: Long pleats stay smooth without coarse weave or broken seams.

underside.note: Curtain bottom and many individual hanging rings remain continuous across the span.

clay.note: Fold depth is actual geometry and stays legible without color.

front.note: Rounded blue bottle, fine lower fluting and gold pump form a recognizable dispenser.

rear.note: Rear bottle shape and pump stem remain joined with clean highlights.

detail.note: Pump cap, neck collar and restrained bottle flutes have visible layered construction.

underside.note: Full-size underside confirms a closed rounded base, not an open vessel.

clay.note: Rounded shoulder and fine flutes remain distinct without glossy ceramic response.

front.note: Recessed oval basin and smooth pedestal clearly identify the standalone fixture.

rear.note: Rear deck fittings and pedestal transition remain attached and coherent.

detail.note: Drain, overflow and separate taps remain visible inside the actual basin cavity.

underside.note: Closed foot and continuous basin underside show no missing exterior faces.

clay.note: The recessed bowl and pedestal remain legible without bright white gloss.

front.note: Three warm rounded diffusers remain connected to the horizontal mounting bar.

rear.note: Rear gold bar and small end caps stay seated behind each diffuser.

detail.note: Smooth rounded diffuser corners and shallow mounting depth remain readable despite emission.

underside.note: Closed light covers and mounting bar remain coherent from below.

clay.note: Three separate rounded cylindrical covers remain clear; the source design is cylindrical rather than spherical globes.

front.note: White roll and hanging paper tail sit on a clear gold spindle.

rear.note: Round wall plate and return arm remain joined to the roll support.

detail.note: Recessed cardboard center and layered paper end remain readable.

underside.note: Holder spindle and hanging sheet remain attached without a floating roll.

clay.note: Roll opening and paper tail remain legible as real construction details.

front.note: Slim mint handle and rows of pale bristle tufts retain the small accessory silhouette.

rear.note: Back of the head and continuous handle remain closed and aligned.

detail.note: Separate bristle tufts and small handle inset are readable; detail is appropriately restrained.

underside.note: Closed handle end and attached bristle rows remain coherent.

clay.note: The head, neck and bristle array remain distinct without color.

front.note: Blue tumbler has a smooth rounded lip and visibly hollow interior.

rear.note: Turned body remains continuous with no coarse silhouette corners.

detail.note: Rolled lip has a restrained ceramic highlight and real wall thickness.

underside.note: Closed darkened bottom is visible below the body; no opening remains at the base.

clay.note: Inner cavity and rolled rim remain clear geometry without gloss.

front.note: Long gold rail joins two circular wall plates with small end collars.

rear.note: Both mounting backs are closed and maintain the wall offset.

detail.note: Restrained linear highlights preserve the straight bar and fine end fittings.

underside.note: Connections remain seated at both ends without detached collars.

clay.note: Simple bar and paired mounts remain legible with softly finished edges.

front.note: Continuous gold ring hangs from a small offset wall mount.

rear.note: Rear disc and upper hinge remain visibly attached to the ring.

detail.note: Thin round section and restrained metal finish remain clear; a small construction seam is retained.

underside.note: Ring remains closed and connected to its upper mounting fitting.

clay.note: Round towel-loop silhouette remains coherent without reflective highlights.

front.note: Shallow tray has a real recessed center and softly rounded rectangular rim.

rear.note: Continuous back rim and low profile remain level and closed.

detail.note: Inner corners and lip thickness stay legible with restrained white surface response.

underside.note: Closed underside follows the same rounded outline without holes or detached trim.

clay.note: Recess and continuous rim remain geometric rather than painted shading.

front.note: Tall tub, front access door and internal grab rail read clearly as a seated fixture.

rear.note: Closed rear shell and smooth corners remain continuous.

detail.note: Door seal, small hinges, latch and grab rail remain distinct at close range.

underside.note: Bottom is closed and door fittings stay attached to the shell.

clay.note: Recessed basin and door construction remain legible without white gloss.

front.note: Three open wooden shelves show improved directional grain and softened construction edges.

rear.note: Rear uprights meet all three shelves with no missing joints.

detail.note: Fine wood grain and layered shelf edges improve the otherwise simple storage frame.

underside.note: Closed shelf undersides and four feet are coherent; this inherited model has no wheels.

clay.note: The geometry reads as a stationary utility shelf despite its trolley name; this limitation is retained explicitly.

front.note: Request correction: rounded case still lacks a convincing recessed cup and dispensing area.

rear.note: Rear enclosure and hopper remain coherent, but surface refinement alone does not address the weak appliance construction.

detail.note: Two solid pegs on a flat face do not read as functioning coffee outlets; add a measured recess and outlet ends.

underside.note: Narrow tray remains flush with the case and provides little visible cup clearance beneath the pegs.

clay.note: Material-free view confirms the appliance remains largely a rounded box; geometry needs an individual dispensing-space refinement.

front.note: Soft white seat over mint frame and a low storage shelf makes a clear entry bench.

rear.note: Rear legs and shelf remain connected beneath the tailored seat.

detail.note: Seat loft and restrained edge shaping improve softness; lower storage blocks remain deliberately simple.

underside.note: Four legs, closed seat support and lower shelf remain attached.

clay.note: Layered cushion, frame and storage shelf stay distinct without material contrast.
